verdict.rationale: Chroma is a vector database with a managed cloud service, and such a platform could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring jobs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents scheduling, cron, or recurring workflows. Automatic embedding and indexing is a one-off ingestion behavior, not a recurring schedule, and forking is unrelated to scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
